name: Gusty offshore
notes: Wind model #10: 14-20 kn, oscillation +/-12 deg, no persistent trend; frequent, strong puffs with wide fanning, and deep lulls. #221 overrides #10's 90-120 s period with 60-70 s, the fastest of the four: 60 s is the shortest period the 30 s knots draw cleanly (ADR 0001).
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage and drift as fractions.

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's wobble: wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. Strength is fixed for the race (#10), so there is no strength-channel tuning.

Version 3 (#221, #233) is version 2 with only three values changed: the period 60-70 s (was 90-120 s), the wobble 4 deg (was 1.5 deg), readable but never outlasting its 30 s window, and the puff fan 12 deg (was 8 deg), about 1.5 x, so a puff can decide which tack is favoured. The amplitude and every other puff column are unchanged.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning on the #232 sliders: the 60-70 s period, the 4 deg wobble and the 12 deg fan (#221), and the other puff columns, set from #10's words (frequent, strong, wide fanning, deep lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).
